extracted.name: Homemade Baked Tortilla Chips
extracted.description: Tortillas, salt, olive oil, and an oven are all you need to prepare these homemade baked tortilla chips.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cut tortillas into 6 wedges each. Place on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Season with salt.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden and crisp, about 5 minutes.
